# MCC Group

> MCC Group is a civil construction group based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, founded in 1984. It is a Class 1A registered contractor with PWD Maharashtra, has more than 120 people, and works in Maharashtra and Telangana. Roads, bridges, canals, dams, buildings, PEB structures and related civil works.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1984
- Leadership: Sanjay Heda (Founder President), Mahendra Heda (Executive Director)
- Group companies: Mahendra Construction, Mahendra Irricon Pvt Ltd, Mahagauri Buildcon, Mahagauri Infra, Mahagauri Construction (civil construction); Mahagauri Stone Crusher Pvt Ltd (stone crushing)
- Address: 908, B Wing, Lokmat Building, Lokmat Square, Nagpur 440010
- Telephone: 0712-4210767; mobile and WhatsApp 90497 70088
- Email: msh@mccgroup.in
- Office hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 6 PM IST

## Articles (by Mahendra Heda; English, Hindi and Marathi)
- [PEB or conventional construction: how to choose](https://mccgroup.in/insights/peb-vs-conventional-construction/): A plain comparison of pre-engineered steel buildings and conventional RCC construction: speed, span, flexibility, and when each one fits.
- [Storm drain planning in layouts: what to get right](https://mccgroup.in/insights/storm-drain-planning-in-layouts/): Why storm drains matter in residential and commercial layouts, and the points to settle during planning so water leaves the site safely.
- [Why timeline control decides project cost](https://mccgroup.in/insights/timeline-control-and-project-cost/): How delays raise the cost of a civil project, and how planning manpower and machinery together keeps a project on schedule and viable.
- [Canal lining explained](https://mccgroup.in/insights/canal-lining-explained/): What canal lining is, why canals are lined, how the work is done, and what makes a lining last.
